transcript.text: If I am in a trade and it goes up and
I'm in a winning position, I do not let
that turn into a loser. At the worst,
I'll stop at break even. But typically,
I end up seeing an exit indicator before
it comes to break even. That can be in
the form of a large seller on the level
two or it could be just in the form of a
burst of selling that goes through a
time in sales where the stock doesn't go
where I thought it would go. Because the
moment I get in, what are things I need
to see in order to see the stock go
higher? We need to see buying. We need
to see green on the level two. We need
to see green on the tape. We need to see
a big green volume bar. So the absence
of that buying volume by itself for me
can indicate nah, I better just step off
of this so I can get out with a small
winner.

metadata.title: Avoid Turning Winners to Losers (Day Trading)
